title: Roth IRA income phase-out — 2026
facts: Single i Head of Household: Roth IRA contribution phase-out przy modified AGI $153,000–$168,000.
Married Filing Jointly i Qualifying Surviving Spouse: phase-out $242,000–$252,000.
Married Filing Separately przy mieszkaniu z małżonkiem w roku: phase-out $0–$10,000.
Ogólny 2026 łączny limit Traditional i Roth IRA wynosi $7,500 albo $8,600 dla age 50+, z zastrzeżeniem taxable compensation.
